question: What was revenue last quarter?

interpretations.label: Q3 2018 (latest calendar quarter, partial), GMV
interpretations.sql: SELECT sum(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01'

interpretations.label: Q2 2018 (last complete quarter), GMV
interpretations.sql: SELECT sum(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'

interpretations.label: Q2 2018, items + freight
interpretations.sql: SELECT sum(oi.price + oi.freight_value) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'

question: Who are our best customers?

interpretations.label: top 5 people by lifetime GMV
interpretations.sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, sum(oi.price) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

interpretations.label: top 5 people by number of orders
interpretations.sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

question: How fast is our delivery?

interpretations.label: mean purchase-to-delivery days
interpretations.sql: SELECT avg(date_diff('second', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date) / 86400.0) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

interpretations.label: median purchase-to-delivery days
interpretations.sql: SELECT median(date_diff('second', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date) / 86400.0) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

interpretations.label: mean carrier-to-customer days
interpretations.sql: SELECT avg(date_diff('second', o.order_delivered_carrier_date, o.order_delivered_customer_date) / 86400.0) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What's our top category?

interpretations.label: by GMV
interpretations.sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, sum(oi.price) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: by items sold
interpretations.sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, count(*) v FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many late orders did we have in 2018?

interpretations.label: delivered after the estimated date (date level)
interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)

interpretations.label: delivered after the estimated timestamp (midnight)
interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date

interpretations.label: date-level late plus never delivered past the estimate
interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND ((o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)) OR (o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-10-17'))

question: Which product category grew the most?

interpretations.label: largest absolute GMV increase, Jan-Aug 2018 vs Jan-Aug 2017
interpretations.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT t.product_category_name_english cat, sum(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01') g18, sum(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01') g17 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT cat, g18 - g17 FROM x ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: largest relative GMV growth (min 10k BRL in 2017 Jan-Aug)
interpretations.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT t.product_category_name_english cat, sum(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01') g18, sum(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01') g17 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT cat, g18 / g17 - 1 FROM x WHERE g17 >= 10000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What's our customer retention rate?

interpretations.label: lifetime share of people with 2+ valid orders
interpretations.sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT avg(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM pc

interpretations.label: share of 2017-active people who ordered again in 2018
interpretations.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01') SELECT avg(CASE WHEN b.customer_unique_id IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END) FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (customer_unique_id)

interpretations.label: share with a second order within 90 days of the first (first order before 2018-07)
interpretations.sql: WITH po AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id u, o.order_purchase_timestamp ts FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), f AS (SELECT u, min(ts) f FROM po GROUP BY 1 HAVING min(ts) < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01') SELECT avg(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM po WHERE po.u = f.u AND po.ts > f.f AND po.ts <= f.f + INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM f

question: Show me sales by region.

interpretations.label: GMV by customer state (27 rows)
interpretations.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, sum(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

interpretations.label: GMV by IBGE macro-region of the customer (5 rows)
interpretations.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_state IN ('AM','PA','RR','AP','AC','RO','TO') THEN 'North'
            WHEN c.customer_state IN ('MA','PI','CE','RN','PB','PE','AL','SE','BA') THEN 'Northeast'
            WHEN c.customer_state IN ('MT','MS','GO','DF') THEN 'Center-West'
            WHEN c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ','MG','ES') THEN 'Southeast'
            ELSE 'South' END AS region, sum(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

interpretations.label: GMV by seller state
interpretations.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, sum(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
